hints.title: Greedy Character Selection
hints.text: Always pick the largest available character to make the string lexicographically as large as possible.

hints.title: Observe Repeat Limit
hints.text: Take at most repeatLimit copies of the largest character.

hints.title: Insert Single Separator
hints.text: If copies of the largest character remain, insert a single copy of the next largest available character to break the repetition.
